skill_name: Compare and contrast two methods of teaching using technology.
workflow:
Traditional face-to-face teaching and teaching using technology are two different ways of delivering instruction. 

The most obvious difference between the two methods is the use of technology. Traditional face-to-face instruction requires the physical presence of the teacher and students in the same room, while teaching using technology relies on the use of digital mediums. This can include online platforms such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meet, but can also include virtual classrooms,
